thread:
devon: FYI, rollout of apps-shard-3 finished but several GPU namespaces didn't finish sync. Argo stuck on prune for ~30m.
maria: which namespaces? any errors in argocd? /cc @kyle
kyle: app-of-apps `apps-shard-3` stuck reconciling child app `gpu-pool-west-2` — controller logs show lease ttl mismatch + "prune wave timeout". pasting logs.
kyle: ```text
2026-03-17T10:08:21Z controller: sync failed: prune wave timeout (20s)
2026-03-17T10:08:21Z controller: failed to acquire app lock: lease expired for apps-shard-3-lease
```
ashley: saw autoscaler complaining: can't attach nodes to pool because nodegroup-create job didn't run — helm hook Job didn't complete.
devon: sigh — I think fanout during the parent sync caused too many concurrent reconciles; argocd worker concurrency default is high and we had ~40 child apps in the shard.
lee: also saw lots of 429s from cloud-apis (quota throttle) during the rollout — likely the root cause of helm-job timeouts.
sre-bot: alert: GPU-pool-west-2 PruneWaveTimeout severity=warning at 2026-03-17T10:12Z
maria: Can we stop new rollouts and revert apps-shard-3? set app-of-apps to paused for now.
kyle: paused parent app: `argocd app set apps-shard-3 --pause` and scaled application-controller down to reduce parallelism: `kubectl -n argocd scale deployment argocd-application-controller --replicas=2`.
ashley: status: helm hook `create-nodegroup` pod `create-nodegroup-xyz` is CrashLoopBackOff, logs show IAM API rate limit: "Throttling: Rate exceeded".
devon: temporary mitigation idea — annotate the heavy infra children with `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: Prune=false` so prune won't run and we can repair infra first.
maria: that works. Then we can run targeted prunes once cloud API calls settle.
kyle: plan:
- mark affected child apps with Prune=false
- wait for quota to calm (or request quota bump)
- manually sync `argocd app sync gpu-pool-west-2 --prune --timeout 300s` when ready
- re-run failed helm hooks / jobs with increased backoff
- revert parent auto-rollout to previous commit if needed
lee: also add a small delay between child app updates in the pipeline — terraform/nodegroup creations are slow and we shouldn't fan them out.
devon: applying Prune=false overlay to Kustomize now, will push commit and post sha.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: apps-shard-3 overlay commit abc123 -> applying diff
kyle: long-term: reduce prune-wave concurrency and add per-shard rate limiting on cloud API calls; maybe implement a leaky-bucket in the pipeline or per-shard gate.
ashley: re-ran failed helm hook with bumped backoff and it succeeded for two namespaces.
maria: OK after prunes disabled we can run controlled reconcile 1-by-1. monitor autoscaler metrics closely — we can't overspin GPUs.
devon: doing manual syncs now with ~60s gap, watching `kube-controller-manager` and autoscaler metrics.
kyle: follow-ups: open GH issue to add shard-aware rollout policy in gitops repo; also doc recommended defaults for argocd prune concurrency.
lee: opened cloud support ticket to request higher nodegroup API quota for us-west-2.
maria: thanks all. ping me if any namespace flaps. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: incident cleared (degraded->ok) at 2026-03-17T11:02Z
